newsitem.title: INDONESIA: BZW, UBS say sign $178.87 mln Sengkang gas project.
newsitem.headline: BZW, UBS say sign $178.87 mln Sengkang gas project.

text.p: BZW Asia Limited and Union Bank of Switzerland said on Monday they had signed a $178.875 million financing facility for Indonesia's Sengkang Gasfield and Power Project.
The Sengkang Gasfield and Power Projects is the first natural gas-fired combined cycle independent power and gasfield project in Southeast Asia.

They said the facilities consisted of about $112.9 million 14-year limited recourse facility with 90 percent export credit insurance and about $25.5 million 14-year uncovered limited recourse facility to PT Energi Sengkang.
They said it also consisted of a $40.5 million 10.5 year uncovered limited recourse facility to Energy Equity Tenneco (Sengkang) Pty Ltd.
PT Energi Sengkang and Energy Equity Tenneco (Sengkang) Pty Ltd. are the project companies.
They said syndication of the facilities closed about 20 percent oversubscribed, raising a total of $215 million from a group of 11 European, Japanese, Canadian and Australian banks.
